full_surface_construction_error.message:
enable_rigid_soft_full_surface_contact=True, but these participating rigid shapes have no signed-distance field: ['shape 0']. The edge and face contact passes sample each rigid mesh/convex shape's SDF, so a shape without one is skipped and a soft body can pass straight through it. Provision an SDF before ModelBuilder.finalize(), any one of these ways:
  - For shapes that use the builder's default config (including importer-added shapes): set builder.default_shape_cfg.configure_sdf(force_sdf=True) before you add or import them.
  - For a shape you gave an explicit config: call configure_sdf() on that config, e.g. cfg.configure_sdf(force_sdf=True) (optionally max_resolution=... or target_voxel_size=...).
  - Manually: build one with mesh.build_sdf() and attach it to the shape.
Or set enable_rigid_soft_full_surface_contact=False to use per-vertex (particle) contacts only.
